name: Cohen--Macaulay Yang Complex
statement: The Yang complex $\Delta_C$, whose facets select the realized literal of every coordinate for each word of $C$, is Cohen--Macaulay over every field.
hypotheses: Finite nonempty binary class; unrealized literals are retained as labeled ghost vertices.
comments: Cohen--Macaulayness over one field is sufficient in the cited binary Yang correspondence, which yields the field-independent ample condition.
